title: 第18章 谁才是好运
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
破庙内。

    厉行天在努力修炼，根据他自己的计划，他需要尽快的突破到筑基期。

    根据系统提示，此刻厉行天的修为则是在炼气八层。

    估摸还得要个两天的时间。

    李应灵和宁芊芊则是在喝鸡汤，毕竟此刻的两人，李应灵就算临时抱佛脚也不可能像炼气期一样有大提升。

    她此前只是修仙天才，并不是大能转世。

    至于宁芊芊……连收徒条件都不能满足，估计资质也是够呛，练了白练，多喝点鸡汤补补更实在一些。

    此刻自己的修为是无暇金丹中期，等厉行天筑基之后，应该就能到金丹后期。

    所以这宗门之中，努力效果最大化的人便是厉行天了，只要他练到了筑基，那么宗门实力便是质的飞跃！

    另外清风宗的情报楚星尘自然也是收集了一些，宗门内有一位太上长老的修为是元婴期。

    就算自己闹了事，这位太上长老不一定会来。

    但好歹在这个世界混了几年，楚星尘也明白得做好最坏的打算，不要对打算要做的事情抱有好的期待。

    因为一切肯定都会向最倒霉的情况倾泻，所以楚星尘特意提醒厉行天按最坏情况做布置，另外哪怕救不了人，也要保证自己这些人能从容撤退。

    毕竟救人只是支线，楚星尘可没善良到能为陌生人去搏上自家徒弟的命。

    不过提起倒霉，楚星尘的目光看向喝鸡汤的李应灵。

    自己这个大徒弟可是有【强运】这个词条，但和她也待了不少时间，没觉得她哪里运气好，也没看见她走路能捡到什么上古宝物之类的好东西。

    出去猎个野鸡都弄的像被野打了一样。

    莫非是自己运气不好，跟自己中和了不成？

    察觉到师父注视的目光，李应灵放下手中的碗，用疑惑的目光看向自家的师父。

    “应灵啊，你觉得你运气怎么样？”楚星尘露出笑容询问。

    李应灵微微歪头回忆了会：“还行吧。”

    反正此刻左右也无事，试试自家徒弟口中的还行是什么水准！

    楚星尘从空间戒指里拿出了两个骰盅。

    说起运气的话，没有什么比这玩意更加的直观了。

    楚星尘将手中的骰盅递给了李应灵：“玩会？比大小？”
content_en:
Inside the ruined temple.

    Li Xingtian is practicing hard. According to his own plan, he needs to break through to the foundation building stage as soon as possible.

    According to the system prompts, Li Xingtian's cultivation at this moment is at the eighth level of Qi Refining.

    It will probably take another two days.

    Li Yingling and Ning Qianqian were drinking chicken soup. After all, even if Li Yingling was cramming for the two of them at this moment, he would not be able to improve as much as he did during the Qi refining period.

    She was just a genius in cultivating immortals before, not the reincarnation of a great power.

    As for Ning Qianqian... he can't even meet the conditions for accepting a disciple, and his qualifications are probably not good enough. He has practiced in vain, and drinking more chicken soup to replenish his strength will be more effective.

    At the moment, my cultivation level is at the middle stage of Wuxia Golden Core. After Li Xingtian builds the foundation, I should be able to reach the late stage of Golden Core.

    Therefore, among this sect, the person who maximizes the results of his efforts is Li Xingtian. As long as he can practice foundation building, then the sect's strength will make a qualitative leap!

    In addition, Chu Xingchen naturally collected some information about the Qingfeng Sect. There was a supreme elder in the sect whose cultivation level was at the Nascent Soul stage.

    Even if he causes trouble, the Supreme Elder may not come.

    But after spending a few years in this world, Chu Xingchen also understood that he had to prepare for the worst and not have good expectations for what he planned to do.

    Because everything will definitely lead to the most unlucky situation, Chu Xingchen specially reminded Li Xingtian to make arrangements according to the worst situation. In addition, even if he cannot save people, he must ensure that he and others can retreat calmly.

    After all, rescuing people was just a side quest, and Chu Xingchen was not kind enough to risk his apprentice's life for a stranger.

    But when he mentioned bad luck, Chu Xingchen looked at Li Yingling who was drinking chicken soup.

    As my eldest disciple, I have the term "Strong Luck", but I have spent a lot of time with her, and I don't think she is lucky, nor do I see any good things like ancient treasures that she can pick up while walking.

    When I go out to hunt pheasants, I feel like I've been beaten.

    Could it be that he was unlucky and that he had neutralized it?

    Sensing his master's gaze, Li Yingling put down the bowl in his hand and looked at his master with doubtful eyes.

    "Ying Ling, how do you think you are lucky?" Chu Xingchen asked with a smile.

    Li Yingling tilted his head slightly and recalled for a while: "It's not bad."

    Anyway, there is nothing going on at the moment, let’s try to see what level my apprentice says is okay!

    Chu Xingchen took out two dice cups from the space ring.

    When it comes to luck, nothing is more intuitive than this thing.

    Chu Xingchen handed the dice cup in his hand to Li Yingling: "Playing? Competing?"
